provenance.record_action: Read archived evidence and write this diagnostic only. No source/L0 edits, cargo invocation or new compiler measurement.
provenance.measurement_provenance_rule: Record-generation state is not the state of the archived binary measurements. Each evidence receipt retains its own exact UTC, source state, commands and binary identity; the batch C binary source provenance remains distinct from concurrent batch D edits.

closure_boundary: Selected V16 coverage and scoped Image/simple inline Equation/captionless Figure repairs do not certify the remaining language cases. Unsupported approximation is never accepted as semantic zero. Current candidate validation is separate and ongoing.

obligations.title: Captioned and numbered Figure constrained measurement
obligations.required_behavior: A captioned figure must reserve its rendered body and caption extent with the actual lexical style, prefix, numbering and spacing. Measurement must not repeat figure progress, callbacks or other document effects.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: The scoped dispatcher repairs Figure only when caption is absent. Existing figure layout constructs progress-dependent numbering and supplement prefixes before drawing body and caption. Captioned figures retain the unsupported approximation in this measurement dispatcher.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: The scoped RED probes cover caption:none. An isolated empty runtime cannot establish the ambient figure index or prefix; adding independent body-plus-caption arithmetic would not reproduce the owning layout contract.

evidence.selector: runs where name is figure-auto or figure-40pt

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Add source-to-Auto-grid probes with caption shorter and longer than body, numbering:none, multiple numbered figures, lexical font changes and explicit caption styling. Verify next-column origin, caption text, prefix/index and spacing against the pinned oracle; assert original locator, request stores and figure-progress state are unchanged during measurement.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: No bilateral captioned-figure width measurement was executed in this subtask. Do not infer the magnitude or universality of a caption failure from the captionless baseline.

obligations.title: Block, contextual and uncertified mathematical measurement
obligations.required_behavior: Accepted mathematical content must reserve the extent of its final rendered result, including block alignment/numbering and context or callback results, without executing callbacks twice or allocating emitting identities during speculative measurement.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: Only inline Equation with finite positive budget and a direct recursive certificate for the explicitly accepted simple-math families uses isolated physical measurement. Block Equation, effect-bearing descendants and other uncertified mathematical composites retain the prior approximation. Tests reject hidden MathCancel function angles, ContextBlock, metadata Content, Ref supplements and ShowRecipe.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: Ambient introspection, block numbering/alignment and callback transcript identity are not supplied by the isolated instance. The positive certificate is deliberately narrower than the full mathematical language.

evidence.selector: equation-auto measures ordinary x + y only

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Build a source matrix for numbered/unnumbered display math, unsupported callback-free composites, context-produced math and math.cancel angle callbacks. Compare occupied grid extent and actual math geometry with the pinned oracle. Observe callback requests, stable locations and effect counts before/after measurement; allow broader certification only after every relevant descendant and embedded function field is audited.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: Negative certificate tests establish non-execution and retained fallback, not that unsupported equations have zero language extent. The ordinary inline x+y result does not certify other mathematical families.

obligations.title: Image font-relative and region-relative dimensions
obligations.required_behavior: An image axis expressed in em or a relative length must resolve against the active font size or the appropriate containing region, preserving aspect/fit and occupied target dimensions.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: For the archived 10pt font and 200pt-wide zero-margin page, width:2em compiles in both products but emits image dimensions 0x0pt in product versus 20x10pt in oracle. width:50% emits 40x20pt in product versus 100x50pt in oracle. width:auto retains 40x20pt in both.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: The selected extract_pt operation remains an explicitly bounded Float/absolute-Length projection. Its public calculator has no font/region argument. Batch D fixes grid measurement using that existing calculator, not resolution or validation of source axes.

evidence.selector: runs em, ratio and auto; includes exact source, argv, UTC and source state

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Add RED probes for width/height in em, percent and affine percent+length under nested font and region changes. Verify emitted image and occupied target dimensions, one-axis aspect preservation and two-axis cover/contain/stretch. Resolve through an existing owner without changing public contracts, or classify and approve any required public contract change first.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: axis-before.json used relative paths and failed at the product sandbox root; only axis-absolute-before.json is semantic evidence. The evidence covers the archived inputs, not every relative-dimension combination.

obligations.title: Image source-axis type diagnostics
obligations.required_behavior: Image width/height must accept the language-supported axis types and reject invalid source types with the appropriate diagnostic and source span; internal numeric representations must not silently become additional source syntax.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: Absolute-path probes show width:true and width:20.0 compile in product while the pinned oracle rejects them. The stdlib image writer forwards axis Values without the typed validation that would reject these source cases.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: The selected image match classifies its private projection. Correcting source argument validation belongs to the stdlib writer and requires diagnostic/span tests; treating all unsupported Values as impossible would conceal the measured acceptance difference.

evidence.selector: runs bool and float, including stderr

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Add width/height invalid-type tests through the public image constructor with boolean, float, integer, string, content and containers, plus supported auto and relative-length controls. Check errors and exact value spans rather than merely nonzero exit; retain internal calculator controls where Float is a legitimate internal representation.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: Only boolean and float source cases were measured bilaterally here. Other invalid-type categories are proposed tests, not reported measurements.

obligations.title: SVG image input support
obligations.required_behavior: Determine and satisfy the repository-approved language support for SVG image input, including image dimension and output behavior; unsupported input must not be reported as a measured successful image case.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: Initial image/align-image/styled-image fixtures using the archived SVG asset are rejected by product with SVG images are not supported yet; the pinned oracle compiles them. The subsequent PNG fixture successfully exercises the scoped measurement repair.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: Image decoding/input-format support is separate from the selected layout projection and constrained-measurement sites. No SVG decoder or input-format change was made.

evidence.selector: initial SVG-input run source bytes, stderr, binary SHA and source state

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Audit the SVG input owner and its approved scope; add a minimal SVG source image and dimensions/fit controls through source compilation. Once supported, verify correct image content and geometry against the pinned oracle and retain malformed-input diagnostics.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: This records an acceptance difference, not evidence that the decoder architecture should copy upstream or that the entire SVG format is currently promised by this owner.

obligations.title: Nested Table body vertical origin
obligations.required_behavior: Nested table content must retain the correct causal vertical position in its containing grid while reserving its width; matching a following column origin does not certify the table body origin.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: The archived table-auto SVG has the green product rectangle at y=-6.58pt versus y=0pt in oracle. Both next-column markers start at x=40pt. The matching width therefore leaves a vertical geometry difference open.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: Batch D uses existing nested-Table physical measurement and changes selected nominal decisions without modifying table/subframe origin policy. The width repair probes deliberately do not convert matching x into full geometry acceptance.

evidence.selector: table-auto source, argv, UTC and binary/state provenance

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Add nested-table Auto/fixed-grid controls at page start and after text, with shapes and text, and verify global body bounds plus row/column origins. Trace the baseline/cap-height transformation through the owning table/subframe path and require a causal RED-to-GREEN test without altering established external dimensions.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: The observation is from this fixed-column nested-table shape fixture. Root cause and prevalence have not been established, and no blanket table-parity defect is inferred.

obligations.title: Missing intermediate contextual cell values
obligations.required_behavior: The contextual table cells must display the values corresponding to their document positions, while updates remain single-effect operations and the final state remains correct.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: context-state baseline compiles in both products and displays FINAL: 2. Oracle also displays intermediate 1 and 2 in the cells; product extraction contains A and B but omits those intermediate values. The original PDFs and exact extracted text/word data are retained.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: The grid changes preserve cache eligibility, projection and existing emission behavior. The baseline shows a preexisting context-realization/emission difference; matching the final state alone does not establish intermediate visible content or full semantic parity.

evidence.selector: context-state; includes source and binary/build provenance

obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Add a source-to-output test requiring cell-position values 1 then 2 and final value 2, with labels or explicit cell boundaries to identify each occurrence. Verify visual/PDF content and source-linked positions, update counts, stable locations and cache-hit/refusal paths; retain the effects-once HITS: 4 control independently.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: Baseline PDF extraction documents the missing values, but the cause has not been isolated to a specific owner. The final count is not evidence that contextual rendering is correct.

obligations.title: Other retained grid extraction and geometry differences
obligations.required_behavior: Retain exact observed text/geometry differences until they are classified at the language level. Do not normalize them into parity or label serializer/extraction mechanics as a language defect without visual/semantic evidence.
obligations.measured_or_source_observed: The grid comparison records a maximum word-box delta of approximately 0.13pt for grid-refused-space; explicit-fill-100 has the same extracted word sequence but different layout text; effects-once reports HITS: 4 in both but differing extraction order/vertical layout. Other small coordinate differences remain in the comparison receipt.
obligations.why_outside_batch_d_closure: These observations were not the causal RED targets for the scoped width corrections. Product-preservation replay and exact comparison retention do not certify upstream parity or prove all extraction differences are visible language errors.
obligations.proposed_refuter_or_resolution_test: Inspect the retained PDFs and source-linked glyph/word geometry. Reduce each discrepancy to a specific source fixture and distinguish visible placement/content from extraction-order mechanics. Require a language-level reproduction before assigning an implementation fix; retain the raw differences regardless.
obligations.limits_of_current_evidence: No significance threshold or root cause was established here; the numerical deltas alone do not prove a language defect. No performance result is inferred from the selected 100-cell corpus.
